summary_1line: Bhishma explains spiritual merits of various gifts—gold, water sources, ghee, sandals, sesame, land, houses, and cows—emphasizing their religious rewards and benefits to ancestors.

image_candidates.scene_text: A devout man presents a cow with a white copper milking vessel to a Brahmana beneath the starry night of Revati.
Villagers and cattle gather gratefully around a newly dug well as clear water rises under the summer sun.
A traveler kneels to offer sandals to a Brahmana whose feet burn on the hot sand of a dusty road.
